metadata.note: BSEB hosts consolidated multi-subject syllabus PDFs for Matriculation (Class 10 / 9) and Intermediate (Classes XI–XII) prepared by SCERT Bihar & Bihar State Text Book Publishing Corporation. Individual subject-wise 2026–27 split PDFs are not published separately on biharboardonline.com.

10.passing_rule: Minimum >30% marks in each of the 5 compulsory division subjects and 150+ aggregate out of 500. English & Optional subject appearance is governed by BSEB Secondary Result Regulations.

subject_groups.codes: 105 Sanskrit, 106 Rashtrabhasha Hindi (for non-Hindi MIL), 107 Arabic, 108 Persian, 109 Bhojpuri (205–209)
110/210 Mathematics (100 M), 112/212 Science (Theory + Internal Assessment = 100 M), 111/211 Social Science (Theory + Project/Literacy = 100 M)
subject_groups.notes: Must obtain >= 30 marks overall in each (Theory + Internal combined in Science & Social Science).

subject_groups.codes: 113 English (Compulsory to appear); Optionals: 114 Adv. Math, 115 Commerce, 116 Economics, 117 Fine Arts, 118 Home Science, 119 Dance, 120 Music, 121 Persian, 122 Sanskrit, 123 Arabic, 124 Maithili
subject_groups.notes: English & Optional marks are excluded from the 500-mark division calculation per official BSEB Secondary Regulations.

12.course_name: Intermediate (+2 Class 12 — Science, Commerce, Arts & Vocational)
12.passing_rule: Must pass separately in Theory (min 30%) and Practical (min 40%) of each subject across minimum 5 subjects (2 Compulsory Languages + 3 Electives). Distinction at 75% (375 marks).

subject_groups.group: Group 1 — Compulsory Language Subjects (2 Papers, 200 Marks)
subject_groups.codes: Hindi (106/206/306), English (105/205/305) & Regional/Classical Languages (Urdu, Maithili, Sanskrit, Prakrit, Magahi, Bhojpuri, Arabic, Persian, Pali, Bangla)
subject_groups.notes: At least one compulsory language must be Hindi or English (valid across Science I.Sc, Commerce I.Com, Arts I.A).

subject_groups.group: Group 2 — Elective Core Subjects (3 Papers, 300 Marks)
subject_groups.codes: I.Sc: Physics (117), Chemistry (118), Biology (119), Maths (121), Agriculture (120) | I.Com: Business Studies (217), Entrepreneurship (218), Economics (219), Accountancy (220) | I.A: History (321), Pol. Sci (322), Geography (323), Economics (326), Sociology (325), Psychology (324), Philosophy (320), Home Sci (319), Music (318), Maths (327)
subject_groups.notes: Textbooks for non-language electives follow NCERT +1/+2 textbooks prescribed by SCERT & Bihar State Text Book Corp.

subject_groups.codes: Additional Language or Elective, plus Trade / CS / MMWT
subject_groups.notes: Marks of passed 6th subject can replace a failed Group-1/Group-2 paper per BSEB Memo BSEB(SS)/KEN/50/2024-307 (except CS, MMWT, Yoga & Phy. Edu. which cannot be swapped).
